title: Define the rich content node schema
description: Extend the versioned serializable content union with explicit text, QR, local-image, shape, row, column, stack, and overlay node variants while keeping persisted content non-executable.
acceptanceCriteria: The content schema has discriminated variants for text, QR, local image, basic shape, row, column, stack, and overlay nodes
Every variant has a stable node identity, version, and only explicit serializable properties
Container child rules reject cycles, invalid child collections, and unknown node kinds with structured diagnostics
Legacy text templates migrate or validate without data loss
Schema round-trip tests preserve every supported variant

steps.details: Locate the TASK-20 content types, validators, migrations, and fixtures; extend those seams rather than introducing a parallel model.
Define the eight discriminated variants, shared identity/version fields, container child collections, and variant-specific serializable properties.
Validate node depth, child shape, identifiers, and known discriminants; preserve existing text records through the current migration path.
Add focused fixtures for each variant plus unknown-kind, cycle, and malformed-child failures; assert serialize/parse equality and named diagnostics.

technicalNotes: Keep this implementation increment within ten minutes by limiting it to schema contracts and focused tests; editor and rendering work belongs to later tasks.
Do not permit functions, React elements, DOM values, HTML, CSS, or library-owned objects in persisted nodes.
